tests.description: Verifies captures delete the piece from the field and play continues normally.
tests.name: Capture removes piece from board
source: async function dragPiece(harness, objName, tx, ty) {
// Build up to a capture: White_Pawn_1 to (0,4), Black_Pawn_2 to (1,3)
harness.assert(harness.getObjects('Black_Pawn_2').length === 0, 'Captured piece is removed from the playing field');
harness.assert(harness.getSceneVariable('WhiteTurn')?.value === false, 'Turn passes to black after the capture');
// Game continues normally after the capture: black pawn (0,1)->(0,2), then white pawn (1,6)->(1,5)
harness.assert(harness.getSceneVariable('WhiteTurn')?.value === true, 'Black can move after a capture; turn returns to white');
harness.assert(harness.getSceneVariable('WhiteTurn')?.value === false, 'White can move; alternation continues after captures');
